purpose: one baseline through the runner's existing training and validation contract on the accepted cpcb-aqi-exceedance artifact, plus the pre-registered model-vs-triad deciding check on identical eval rows

artifact.name: cpcb-aqi-exceedance
artifact.split_description: temporal split on the prediction instant (day D, 23:59 IST): train 2019-2022, eval 2023, holdout 2024; scored rows are complete (n_hours >= 18) cpcb_caaqm PM2.5 station-days with a labelable D+1 (row present, n_hours >= 18; unlabelable rows excluded and counted); the 2025-04..09 partial tail (47,566 station-days) is excluded and counted, the 2025-01..03 and 2025-10..12 hole months are asserted empty; label = D+1 24-hr mean > 90 ug/m3 (CPCB National AQI Poor-band lower breakpoint)

deciding_check.rule: headroom is demonstrated ONLY if the full model beats EVERY triad member with a station-clustered paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero in the model's favour; triad dominance -> recorded defect, drop or re-target; no re-tuning after any score

model_minus_member_ci.note: cluster-aware paired bootstrap on identical eval rows, clusters = station_id; an interval containing zero is inconclusive, not parity
cluster-aware paired bootstrap on identical eval rows, clusters = station_id; an interval containing zero is inconclusive, not parity

global_rate.treatment: constant member, no ranking information; beaten iff the model's cluster-bootstrap AUC CI lies entirely above 0.5

model_auc_ci.note: one-sample cluster-aware bootstrap of AUC, clusters = station_id

deciding_check.scope: eval split only (2023 station-days); prevalence and the seasonal structure are reported beside the number; the sealed holdout (2024) was not evaluated and no holdout figure exists or is implied

scope: runner-contract baseline + deciding check only; no agent loop, no holdout evaluation. Holdout stays sealed until the design is frozen.
